mapper.update: UPDATE log_cleanup_tasks SET status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, deleted_records = #{deletedRecords}, freed_space = #{freedSpace}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE cleanup_id = #{cleanupId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_cleanup_tasks WHERE strategy = #{strategy}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM log_cleanup_tasks WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)
